text: Noor Mahal Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Noor Mahal Type: Monument - Palace Province: Punjab District: Bahawalpur Period: Historic Relative Chronology: 1857 - 1947 CE Description: Noor Mahal palace is in the custody of Pakistan Army in Bahawalpur. It was built in 1872 like an Italian chateau; on neoclassical lines, at a time when modernism had set in. It belonged to the Nawabs of Bahawalpur princely state, during British Raj.
